extraction.Name: Donalda Barker
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded December 6, 1923 by E. O. Frescoln
extraction.Buyer: Donalda Barker and Paul W. Connealy mortgaged the land to P. B. Gordon for $4000
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: the 1917 and prior taxes are paid but on March 2, 1928, taxes amounting to $108.50 had not been paid
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612791 issued; Northeast quarter section 11, township 97, north of range 74; receipt for the patent was signed by the allottee February 14, 1918; on December 4, 1923, Donalda Connealy formerly [Donalda Barker]; no liens or judgments recorded on that date
